name: nacre-mcp

tools.name: glass_check
tools.description: Exposure report for a Solana wallet: first funder, active hours, repeat counterparties, score.

tools.name: pool_depth
tools.description: Live activity of Solana privacy pools (Umbra, Privacy Cash) and estimated hours to reach a crowd of the given depth.

tools.name: route_tokens
tools.description: List chain ids and token symbols reachable through NEAR Intents. Pass chain (e.g. sol, zec, aleo) to list only that chain. Use these exact ids in route_quote / route_create.

chain.description: Optional chain id to filter by

tools.name: route_quote
tools.description: Live quote for a cross-chain transfer through NEAR Intents (no funds move).

from_chain.description: Source chain id, e.g. sol, base, eth, arb, hood

to_chain.description: Destination chain id, e.g. zec, aleo, hood, btc, sol

amount.description: Decimal amount of the source token

recipient.description: Recipient address on the destination chain

refund_to.description: Refund address on the source chain

tools.name: route_create
tools.description: Create a cross-chain transfer through NEAR Intents and return the deposit address to fund. Moves nothing by itself. refund_to defaults to the agent wallet when NACRE_KEYPAIR is set and the source is Solana.

from_chain.description: Source chain id, e.g. sol, base, eth, arb, hood

to_chain.description: Destination chain id, e.g. zec, aleo, hood, btc, sol

amount.description: Decimal amount of the source token

recipient.description: Recipient address on the destination chain

refund_to.description: Refund address on the source chain

tools.name: route_fund
tools.description: Send the quoted amount from the NACRE_KEYPAIR wallet (SOL or USDC on Solana) to a deposit address returned by route_create in this session. Moves real funds. Pays each address once; honours NACRE_MAX_USDC.

tools.name: privacy_plan
tools.description: Plan a private transfer: recommended pool, depth band, expected wait and random margin from live pool rates, plus a random split into unequal parts and privacy hygiene rules. Read-only; nothing moves.

risk.description: How hard you expect to be looked at. Default standard.

deadline_hours.description: Optional: latest acceptable total wait in hours

tools.name: private_rails
tools.description: Catalog of Solana privacy rails (Umbra, Privacy Cash, Token-2022 confidential transfers, Helius Privacy Rings, cross-chain exits): what each hides, mainnet status as of a stated date, and which Nacre tool handles it. Read-only.

tools.name: confidential_check
tools.description: Does a Solana wallet use Token-2022 confidential balances? Lists token accounts with the confidential transfer extension. Amounts are hidden there, counterparties are not. Read-only.

tools.name: ring_activity
tools.description: Live activity of Solana Privacy Rings (Helius, mainnet): transactions per hour, last hour, last 24h and success rate for the Solana Privacy Program. Read-only.

tools.name: ring_check
tools.description: Has a Solana wallet used Privacy Rings? Scans its latest 40 transactions for calls to the Solana Privacy Program. Cannot read private balances. Read-only.

tools.name: ring_balance
tools.description: Decrypt and show the configured wallet's private balances in Helius Privacy Rings (local server; needs NACRE_KEYPAIR and NACRE_HELIUS_KEY).

tools.name: ring_deposit
tools.description: Deposit SOL or USDC from the configured wallet into its own Privacy Rings private balance (registers the wallet on first use). The deposit itself is public; the balance after it is encrypted. Moves real funds.

tools.name: ring_transfer
tools.description: Send SOL or USDC privately from the private balance to another registered Privacy Rings wallet. Asset and amount are encrypted on-chain. Moves real funds.

to.description: Recipient Solana address (must be registered in Privacy Rings)

tools.name: ring_withdraw
tools.description: Withdraw SOL or USDC from the private balance to a public Solana address (default: own wallet). The withdrawal is public. Moves real funds.

tools.name: deposit_windows
tools.description: Busiest UTC hours of day for Solana privacy pools (Umbra, Privacy Cash), the next busy window, and whether now is a good time to deposit. A deposit inside a busy window lands in a bigger crowd. Read-only.

tools.name: link_check
tools.description: Can a tracker link two Solana wallets? Compares first funder, direct contact, shared counterparties and active hours from each wallet's latest 100 transactions. Use before paying from one wallet to another or funding a fresh address. Read-only.

tools.name: glass_check_batch
tools.description: Glass Check up to 10 Solana wallets at once, ranked by exposure, and flag wallets that share a funder. Use before paying several counterparties or when auditing an agent fleet.

tools.name: policy_status
tools.description: Show the active local spend policy (NACRE_POLICY), what was spent today (UTC) and what is left. Local server only.

tools.name: route_status
tools.description: Status of a NEAR Intents transfer by deposit address.

tools.name: shield
tools.description: Shield USDC from the configured wallet into an Umbra encrypted balance (Solana mainnet).

tools.name: unshield
tools.description: Withdraw USDC from the Umbra encrypted balance to an address (default: own wallet).

tools.name: private_balance
tools.description: Decrypt and show the configured wallet's Umbra USDC balance.

instructions: Nacre is a privacy router for agents on Solana. Typical flow: glass_check (or glass_check_batch for several) a counterparty or your own wallet before paying; ring_activity and ring_check for Helius Privacy Rings; privacy_plan to choose a pool, depth, wait and split for an amount; private_rails to see which Solana privacy rails are live; confidential_check to see if a wallet uses Token-2022 confidential balances; deposit_windows for the busiest hours to deposit; link_check before moving value between two of your own wallets; or pool_depth for raw rates; shield USDC into an Umbra encrypted balance (local server with NACRE_KEYPAIR); or use Helius Privacy Rings (local server with NACRE_KEYPAIR and NACRE_HELIUS_KEY): ring_deposit SOL or USDC, ring_transfer to another registered wallet, ring_withdraw to a public address, ring_balance to read it; route_tokens then route_quote for a cross-chain exit (Zcash, Aleo, Bitcoin, Robinhood Chain and more); route_create returns a deposit address, route_fund pays it from the agent wallet (or fund it yourself), then poll route_status until SUCCESS. Amounts are decimal strings. shield, unshield, ring_deposit, ring_transfer, ring_withdraw and route_fund move real funds: confirm amounts and addresses first. If the operator set NACRE_POLICY, spend limits and allow/block lists apply to shield, unshield, route_create and route_fund; policy_status shows them. Privacy is risk reduction, not a guarantee.
